query: For qualitative work, what interview/sample sizes, high/low-case selection criteria, saturation rule, and inter-coder reliability metrics will we commit to in the protocol?

response.query: For qualitative work, what interview/sample sizes, high/low-case selection criteria, saturation rule, and inter-coder reliability metrics will we commit to in the protocol?
response.answer: For qualitative work, aim for 12-20 interviews for sample size, select high-case examples for depth, use thematic saturation as the stopping rule, and commit to inter-coder reliability above 80%.
